stories.headline: Somalia: Egypt Condemns Opening of So-Called Somaliland Embassy in Al-Quds
stories.summary: Egypt has strongly condemned the opening of a so-called "Somaliland" embassy in Al-Quds, occupied East Jerusalem. The Egyptian Foreign Minister held telephone discussions with counterparts to address the issue. The move has also been condemned by Turkey, Djibouti, Somalia, and the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC), which described it as a blatant violation of international law. Somalia has termed the decision "illegal" and "provocative". The OIC General Secretariat reiterated its condemnation of the intention to open the embassy, citing it as a sign of disregard for international consensus. The condemnations come after Israel's recognition of Somaliland, which has sparked widespread criticism from the international community. The development has heightened tensions in the region, with several countries rejecting the legitimacy of the so-called "Somaliland" embassy in Jerusalem.

stories.headline: DR Congo: Renewed Repression, Impunity Top Rights Concerns
stories.summary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is experiencing renewed repression and impunity, with grave human rights abuses committed by parties to the conflict in eastern Congo. The Congolese army, Wazalendo militia, and Rwanda-backed M23 rebel forces are among those responsible for the abuses. Recent surges in violence have resulted in 602 extrajudicial or summary executions in North and South Kivu over two months. Human Rights Watch has raised concerns with senior officials, urging a change in course to address these issues. The UN Human Rights Council has also discussed the human rights situation in the DRC, as well as allegations of ongoing abuses in South Sudan and the Central African Republic. Civilians continue to bear the brunt of the violence, with ongoing conflicts and abuses persisting in the region.

stories.headline: East Africa ramps up Ebola response as Uganda, DRC and South Sudan hold crisis talks in Kampala
stories.summary: Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), and South Sudan are holding crisis talks in Kampala to discuss the Ebola outbreak response. The World Health Organization (WHO) and the Africa CDC are working together to combat the outbreak. The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has activated its emergency response center and plans to send more personnel to the DRC and Uganda. The US has also enhanced screenings for travelers from affected regions and restricted non-US passport holders who have visited Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan in the past three weeks. International coordination is being ramped up to prevent the epidemic's spread, with a 72-hour Incident Action Plan covering DRC and Uganda responses and South Sudan preparedness. The Africa CDC Director General has met with the President of Uganda and Ministers of Health from the affected countries.

stories.headline: Rwanda, Russia Military Officials Review Defence Cooperation
stories.summary: Senior military officials from Rwanda and Russia are meeting in Kigali to review bilateral defence cooperation and explore new areas of collaboration. The session is co-chaired by Anatoly Punchuk, Deputy Director of the Russian Federal Service for Military and Technical Cooperation, and Brig Gen Patrick Karuretwa, Director General International Military Cooperation in Rwanda's Ministry of Defence. This meeting comes as Russia is involved in a military operation in Ukraine, with recent reports of liberating two communities and ongoing clashes. Additionally, Russia is facing scrutiny over its alleged intelligence support to Iran in its conflict with the US and Israel, raising questions about the scope of Russia-Iran military cooperation. The talks in Kigali aim to strengthen defence ties between Rwanda and Russia, with discussions focusing on progress and potential new areas of cooperation.

stories.headline: Galaxy Z Fold 8 launches July 22 at Unpacked London but rising memory costs could push the top model past $2,700.
stories.summary: Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8 is set to launch on July 22 at the Unpacked event in London. The company traditionally holds a summer Unpacked event for its foldable devices. Rising memory costs may impact the pricing of the top model, potentially pushing it past $2,700. Early rumors suggested the base storage configuration might avoid a price hike, but this is uncertain. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 is expected to be unveiled alongside the Galaxy Z Flip 8. Key specs for the devices have leaked, including details on the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Wide. The launch event will mark the second Unpacked event of the year, with London confirmed as the host city. The exact pricing and specifications will be confirmed at the event. Samsung's foldable devices are highly anticipated, with fans eagerly awaiting the latest upgrades and features.

stories.headline: Samsung patent hints at a rollable phone with movable camera module
stories.summary: Samsung has filed a patent for a rollable phone with a movable camera module. The design features a side-rolling display, allowing the screen to expand. The camera module is integrated into the rolling mechanism, moving with the screen as it expands or contracts. This unique implementation suggests that Samsung is exploring innovative solutions for camera placement in rollable devices. The patent is one of several filed by Samsung for rollable or sliding phones, indicating the company's interest in developing new form factors. While the device is still a concept, the patent reveals Samsung's ongoing research into flexible display technology and its potential applications in mobile devices. The company has established itself as a leader in foldable smartphones and may be looking to expand its offerings in the emerging rollable phone market.

stories.headline: Design of an ultra-compact and high-performance antenna for private 5G applications
stories.summary: Researchers have designed an ultra-compact and high-performance antenna for private 5G applications, addressing significant size constraints. The proposed antenna operates in the 28-30 GHz frequency band and features a metamaterial-based microstrip patch design with Complementary Split-Ring Resonator structures. This design enhances impedance matching, miniaturization, and performance. Simulated radiation patterns and gain characteristics closely match measured values, demonstrating excellent agreement. The antenna is designed on a Rogers RT/duroid 5880 substrate and offers a compact, cost-effective solution for multiband, reconfigurable wireless communication systems. This study bridges the gap between traditional and next-generation antenna designs, providing a useful step-by-step design procedure for practical applications in private 5G systems. The design can be integrated into various 5G and future 6G systems, including MIMO antennas with metasurfaces for high-performance mmWave applications.

stories.headline: The Multi Derma System MDS 3000 is a professional skin-analysis platform designed for cosmetic consultations and treatment planning, featur
stories.summary: The Multi Derma System MDS 3000 is a professional skin-analysis platform designed for cosmetic consultations and treatment planning. It features a detachable tablet interface, integrated Wi-Fi, and a web-based touchscreen workflow. The system combines the Visioscope PC 35 camera with measurements for hydration, sebum, elasticity, skin age, pigmentation, and redness. Optional modules expand its capabilities. Developed by Courage + Khazaka electronic GmbH, a leader in skin testing equipment, the MDS 3000 builds on the success of its predecessor, the MDS 1000. It provides fast, precise, and flexible skin analysis, enabling beauty professionals to demonstrate expertise and enhance product recommendations. The system is suitable for clinics, spas, skincare brands, and beauty tech companies, offering advanced skin diagnostics and analysis solutions. It is part of the company's range of facial skin analyzer machines and professional skin analysis tools.

stories.headline: Virat Kohli 58 runs away from historic IPL record; set to overtake Chris Gayle, David Warner and KL Rahul
stories.summary: Virat Kohli is on the verge of setting a new IPL record, surpassing Chris Gayle, David Warner, and KL Rahul. He requires 58 more runs to become the first player in IPL history to record four consecutive seasons with 600 or more runs. Currently, Kohli is tied with Gayle, Warner, and Rahul, who have achieved three consecutive 600-plus run seasons. The Royal Challengers Bengaluru stalwart will attempt to break the record in his team's final league-stage match against Sunrisers Hyderabad. A strong performance from Kohli will cement his place in the record books, solidifying his position as one of the greatest batsmen in IPL history. The match is a high-stakes encounter, with a direct ticket to a top-two finish on the line.

stories.headline: NBA: Cavs in trouble, down 2-0 and Mitchell not fully healthy
stories.summary: The Cleveland Cavaliers are trailing 2-0 in the Eastern Conference finals after a 109-93 loss to the Knicks. The team's situation is further complicated by the health of superstar Donovan Mitchell, who is not fully healthy. Mitchell had trouble getting up after a play, raising concerns about his condition. The Cavaliers' chances of coming back from a 2-0 deficit are slim, and Mitchell's health issues may hinder their ability to mount a comeback. The Knicks' dominant performance has put the Cavaliers in a difficult position, and they will need to regroup and find a way to win on the road to stay in the series. The Cavaliers' struggles have been anticipated by some, with concerns about the team's ceiling with Mitchell as the leader.

stories.headline: Big guns return as Pakistan name strong squad for Australia ODIs
stories.summary: Pakistan has announced a strong squad for the upcoming ODI series against Australia. Mohammad Rizwan will lead the team as the new white-ball captain, replacing Babar Azam. Notable players returning to the squad include Babar Azam, Shadab Khan, and Naseem Shah. Abdul Samad also makes a comeback as a power-hitter, while Usman Khan has been included as a wicket-keeper. The squad's announcement comes after Australia revealed their team for the series, which has been referred to as their 'C' team. The ODI series is set to take place in Pakistan, with the exact dates not specified. The return of key players is expected to bolster Pakistan's chances against the Australian team. The squad's composition suggests a strong lineup, with a mix of experienced players and power-hitters.

stories.headline: First-lap failure stops new Erebus Camaro Cooper Murray's debut in a brand new Erebus Camaro is off to a shaky start with the car suffering a suspension failure on its first practice lap.
stories.summary: Cooper Murray's debut in a brand new Erebus Camaro has been disrupted by a suspension failure on its first practice lap. The issue occurred during initial testing, causing an early setback for the driver. Murray reported that the car was experiencing tire shake while traveling straight, and separate issues with the fuel pump and brake fluid were also noted. The fuel pump failure led to the engine shutting off, and the brake fluid boiling over. This incident marks an unfortunate start to Murray's campaign in the new Erebus Camaro, with the team now facing repairs and adjustments before returning to competition. The exact cause of the suspension failure is not specified, but the team will need to address the issue to get Murray back on track.

stories.headline: How the West Misreads Modi’s Success India may be less liberal now, but it remains democratic.
stories.summary: India has become a key topic in global discussions on populism, democratic erosion, and nationalism. Prime Minister Narendra Modi's decade in power has seen a shift away from liberal values, with critics arguing that democracy is eroding and inequality is rising. Despite this, India remains a democratic country. Modi's government has been accused of promoting religious nationalism, which some say diverts attention from pressing issues. Recently, the Indian Prime Minister made remarks on regional peace that were criticized by the Foreign Office as "misleading and one-sided". Scholars like Pratap Bhanu Mehta have discussed the impact of Modi's rule on power, conformity, and dissent in modern India, highlighting concerns about the state of liberalism and democracy in the country.

stories.headline: Biden Administration Faces Backlash Over New Immigration Policy
stories.summary: The Biden administration is facing backlash over its new immigration policy, which has led to historic migration flows and strained resources. Between 2021 and 2024, there were over 11 million border encounters and at least 7.2 million illegal crossings. Despite warnings from advisers that the policy could lead to "chaos" at the border, the administration proceeded with its plans. A newly uncovered memo reveals that President Biden ignored these warnings, and a lawsuit has been filed by Texas residents alleging that the administration failed to consider the environmental impacts of its asylum and immigration programs. The policy shifts, which included expanding parole and widening asylum criteria, have led to habitat degradation and other harms, and have contributed to a loss of faith in the administration's handling of immigration. The crisis has had significant consequences, including the return of Donald Trump to the White House.

stories.headline: US Senate Votes to Approve Landmark Bipartisan Bill on Election Reform
stories.summary: The US Senate has voted to approve a landmark bipartisan bill on election reform, aimed at combating fraudulent advertisements in elections. The bill was introduced by Representatives Brian Fitzpatrick, Derek Kilmer, Lori Chavez-DeRemer, and Adam Schiff. Senate Majority Leader John Thune pushed for a vote on the bill, which was narrowly advanced by Senate Republicans. This development comes as the Senate also announced a bipartisan framework to address recent mass shootings, including measured gun restrictions and efforts to improve school safety and mental health programs. The bipartisan efforts demonstrate a rare show of unity in the Senate, with lawmakers working together to address key issues ahead of a self-imposed July 4 deadline for passing a budget bill pivotal to President Donald Trump's agenda. The bills' passage marks a significant step towards election reform and gun control.

stories.headline: European Union Leaders Meet to Discuss Rising Tensions with Russia
stories.summary: European Union leaders are meeting to discuss rising tensions with Russia, with a focus on developing a unified European voice for talks with the Kremlin. European Council President António Costa has stated that the EU has the potential to negotiate with Russia, with the support of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Former German Chancellor Angela Merkel has also suggested that the EU should make use of its diplomatic potential and not rely solely on the US for peace talks. EU foreign ministers are set to discuss direct talks with Russia during an informal meeting in Cyprus, as well as how to prevent Russia's attacks on its neighbors. The meeting comes amid concerns over Russia's intentions, with Poland's Prime Minister Donald Tusk warning of a potential attack on Europe's eastern flank within months.

stories.headline: Stock markets today: Sensex rises 300 points; Nifty over 23K
stories.summary: Indian benchmark equity indices, Sensex and Nifty, have seen a rebound in early trade, driven by a rally in global markets and easing Brent crude oil prices. The Sensex rose 300 points, while the Nifty crossed the 23,000 mark. This uptick follows a two-day decline and reflects gains in global markets. Buying in information technology stocks has supported the rally, with volatility easing sharply. The market has also been influenced by hopes of US-Iran peace negotiations and positive global cues, including growing hopes of a US Fed rate cut and foreign fund inflows. The Nifty 50 has traded above 23,730, with the BSE Sensex gaining over 330 points in early trade, indicating a significant recovery in the Indian stock market.

stories.headline: Indian Equities Rally: Banks Lead as Global Trends Boost Market Sentiment
stories.summary: Indian stock market benchmark indices closed higher, driven by strong performance in blue-chip bank shares and a positive trend in global markets. The Sensex jumped 941 points and Nifty reclaimed 24,300, led by gains in banking, financials, auto, and IT stocks. Easing US-Iran tensions and a sharp slide in crude oil prices boosted risk sentiment, contributing to the market's 1% rally. Strong quarterly results from major lenders also supported the uptrend. Global investor sentiment towards India is shifting, with major brokerages like Goldman Sachs and HSBC showing renewed interest. Expectations of potential rate cuts by the US Federal Reserve and the Reserve Bank of India further supported investor sentiment, easing volatility and turning technicals positive. The Indian market extended its winning streak for the fourth consecutive day, driven by these positive factors.

stories.headline: Stock Market Live Updates Today: Will BSE Sensex, Nifty50 close the week with gains amid high crude oil prices, US
stories.summary: The Indian stock market is expected to close the week with gains despite high crude oil prices. The BSE Sensex and Nifty50 are being closely watched as investors await corporate announcements and react to global market trends. The latest share market live updates show the performance of BSE Sensex stocks, with gainers, losers, and volume toppers being tracked. Investors are also keeping an eye on IPO news, forex, and commodity markets. Real-time insights on Sensex and Nifty Live are available, providing updates on the stock market today. The market mood is being monitored, with experts analyzing the impact of high crude oil prices on the Indian economy. Investors can stay updated with the latest stock market news and live updates on various financial news websites. The stock market's performance will be closely watched as the week comes to a close.

stories.headline: Sensex Today | Stock Market Live: Sensex jumps 350 points, Nifty reclaims 23,750; banks and financials lead gains
stories.summary: The Sensex has jumped 350 points, with the Nifty reclaiming 23,750, led by gains in banks and financials. This surge follows a sharp recovery in the Indian benchmark indices on Monday, where the Sensex rebounded over 1,000 points from the day's low to turn positive and trade above 75,250. Previously, the Sensex had fallen 135 points to close at 75,183, while the Nifty slipped 4 points to settle at 23,655. The Nifty Bank index underperformed, falling 123 points to 53,439 after slipping over 1% from the day's highs. The current gains indicate a positive trend in the market, with banks and financials driving the growth. The Sensex and Nifty are being closely monitored, with real-time updates and charts available to track their performance.

stories.headline: [Trefis] Stress Testing ONDS: Historical Drawdowns and Macro Risks Every seasoned investor knows that market shocks are inevitable. What matters is the depth of the hit. Historically, across 7 major crises, Ondas (ONDS) absorbs
stories.summary: Ondas (ONDS) has been stress tested against historical drawdowns and macro risks. Across 7 major crises, the company has shown its ability to absorb shocks. The test assesses the depth of potential hits from market shocks, which are considered inevitable by seasoned investors. The analysis aims to determine how well ONDS can withstand significant economic downturns. By examining the company's performance during past crises, investors can better understand its resilience and potential risks. The stress test results can provide valuable insights for investors looking to assess ONDS' stability and make informed decisions. The company's ability to navigate market shocks is crucial for its long-term success and investor confidence.

stories.headline: [PR Newswire] Changan and Kawa achieve a significant milestone with a US$950 million investment and the launch of technologically innovative flexible fuel technology
stories.summary: Changan and Kawa have achieved a significant milestone with a $950 million investment and the launch of innovative flexible fuel technology. This investment is part of a three-year cycle from 2026-2028, aimed at driving technological upgrades and advanced manufacturing processes. The launch coincides with Changan's expansion into global markets, particularly in Europe, where it has introduced its CHANGAN, DEEPAL, and AVATR electric vehicle brands. This strategic move is expected to usher in a new era of electric vehicles in the region. The $950 million investment underscores Changan's commitment to technological innovation and its long-term vision for global market infiltration. The partnership with Kawa and the launch of flexible fuel technology demonstrate Changan's efforts to stay ahead in the automotive industry.

stories.headline: [The Manila Times] Bull delivers Roihu, Finland’s new national supercomputer Paris, France and Helsinki, Finland - 22 May, 2026 -Bull, a leader in advanced computing, today announces the delivery and inauguration of Roihu, Finland’s new
stories.summary: Bull, a leader in advanced computing, has delivered and inaugurated Roihu, Finland's new national supercomputer, hosted by CSC – IT Center for Science. The announcement was made on May 22, 2026, in Paris, France, and Helsinki, Finland. Roihu had previously entered its pilot phase on May 4, 2026, with real-world projects testing the system. The supercomputer is part of the EuroHPC initiative. This development follows another recent announcement by Bull, which delivered a new supercomputing infrastructure for Airbus, Europe's largest aerospace company, as part of a multi-year supercomputing agreement. The inauguration of Roihu marks a significant milestone in Finland's computing capabilities, with the supercomputer expected to support various scientific and research projects. The delivery and inauguration of Roihu demonstrate Bull's expertise in advanced computing and its commitment to supporting cutting-edge research and development.

stories.headline: [Yahoo Finance] Bitcoin Pizza Day 2026 Arrived Over $300 Million Lighter Than Last Year Bitcoin Pizza Day's 10,000 BTC stack lost $328 million in value over 12 months as BTC slid 30% from last year.
stories.summary: Bitcoin Pizza Day 2026 marked a significant decline in value, with the 10,000 BTC stack worth $777.87 million, down from $1.106 billion in 2025. This represents a 29.7% year-over-year decline, the steepest drop since 2015. The value of the stack decreased by $328 million over 12 months as BTC slid 30% from last year. On Bitcoin Pizza Day 2026, Bitcoin traded near $77,787, sitting 29.7% below last year's price of $110,568. The celebration commemorates the first recorded Bitcoin transaction for physical goods, highlighting ongoing volatility in the crypto market. The decline reflects a cooler market climate, with the cryptocurrency market valued over $300 million less than the previous year. The event serves as a reminder of the crypto market's continued fluctuations and economic challenges.

stories.headline: US President Donald Trump abruptly canceled the signing of an artificial intelligence (AI) executive order that would have required tech companies
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump canceled the signing of an executive order on artificial intelligence (AI) that would have required tech companies to partner with the government. The order aimed to lay out partnerships with leading AI companies to vet new technologies. The signing ceremony was scheduled for Thursday, but Trump abruptly halted the plans hours before tech executives were set to attend. The reason for the cancellation is attributed to concerns that the order could weaken America's tech edge. Former AI czar David Sacks and other pressure groups may have also influenced the decision. The executive order's details and its potential impact on the tech industry are still unclear, but its cancellation has sparked interest and speculation about the administration's AI policy. The order's fate and potential revisions remain uncertain.

stories.headline: OpenAI, the U.S. developer of the artificial intelligence chatbot ChatGPT, said Thursday it will provide the Japanese government and some companies with an AI model
stories.summary: OpenAI will provide the Japanese government and select companies with its advanced AI model, "GPT-5.5-Cyber", for enhanced cybersecurity. The US-based developer of the ChatGPT chatbot aims to support Japan's cybersecurity efforts with this latest model. The move is part of OpenAI's expansion into the Japanese market, where it will offer its cutting-edge technology to government agencies and private sector entities. This development comes as the demand for advanced AI models continues to grow, with other companies like Zhipu AI, a Chinese lab, recently capping subscriptions for its GLM-4.7 coding model due to overwhelming usage. OpenAI's decision to provide its GPT-5.5-Cyber model to Japan is expected to bolster the country's cybersecurity capabilities. The exact terms and timeline of the agreement have not been disclosed.

stories.headline: From live speech translation in video calls to auto-dubbing on TikTok, the technology to dissolve language barriers has arrived
stories.summary: Real-time translation powered by artificial intelligence (AI) is now embedded in everyday life, dissolving language barriers. This technology allows for live speech translation in video calls and auto-dubbing on platforms like TikTok. Users can upload or link videos from various platforms, including YouTube, TikTok, and Vimeo, and translate them instantly. Fully managed dubbing services are also available. The benefits of dubbing videos include a wider reach, as language is no longer a barrier, allowing content creators to tap into new demographic regions. Auto-dubbing can be done using AI technology, increasing engagement on platforms like TikTok and YouTube. Additionally, features like text-to-speech tools on TikTok enable users to make their text read out loud in videos, further enhancing accessibility and reach. This technology has made it easier for content to be consumed globally, regardless of language constraints.

stories.headline: How Trump's China visit made him take a U-turn on Anthropic Mythos fears and is good news for Meta, Google, OpenAI and Microsoft
stories.summary: Trump's recent visit to China has led to a shift in his stance on Anthropic's Mythos, an AI model initially withheld due to safety concerns. The White House had invited top tech executives, including those from OpenAI, Google, Meta, and Microsoft, to discuss AI regulation, but many were unable to attend due to scheduling conflicts. Despite this, Trump's delegation included notable tech figures such as Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, and Tim Cook. The development of AI models like Mythos and OpenAI's GPT-5.5 has raised concerns about potential misuse. However, with Chinese labs also developing similar technologies, the US may need to reassess its approach to AI regulation, potentially benefiting companies like Meta, Google, OpenAI, and Microsoft. The Trump administration has taken a largely hands-off approach to AI regulation, but this may change in response to emerging technologies.
